trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Inform the user about the call purpose and ask for verification.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను మీ telecom operator నుండి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాను. మీ అకౌంట్ గురించి కాల్ చేసాము. ముందుగా verification కోసం మీ date of birth చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Provide the verification factor.
steps.text: నా పుట్టిన తేదీ 15th August 1985. త్వరగా చెప్పండి, నేను మీటింగ్ లో ఉన్నాను.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return the verification outcome.
Check current balance and plan details before recommending a recharge.
Return the current subscriber state.
Read the current state to the user and ask for their preference.
steps.text: Verification పూర్తయింది. మీ ప్రస్తుత ప్లాన్ P199, మీ balance 5 రూపాయలు, 1 రోజు validity మరియు 0.2 GB data మిగిలి ఉంది. మీరు ఇదే ప్లాన్ తో కంటిన్యూ చేయాలనుకుంటున్నారా?

steps.purpose: Request a different plan and an out-of-scope benefit.
steps.text: లేదు, వేరే ప్లాన్ కావాలి. అలాగే నాకు Netflix subscription ఫ్రీగా కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request clearly.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, నేను Netflix subscription ఇవ్వలేను, అది మా సర్వీస్ లో లేదు. నేను కేవలం available plans మాత్రమే చెప్పగలను.

steps.purpose: Ask the agent to list the available plans.
steps.text: సరే, అయితే ఏ ప్లాన్స్ ఉన్నాయో త్వరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Fetch available plans for the user.
Return the available plans.
Present the fetched plans to the user.
steps.text: 199 రూపాయలకు 1.5 GB ప్లాన్ మరియు 299 రూపాయలకు 2 GB ప్లాన్ ఉన్నాయి. 299 ప్లాన్ లో OTT included అని ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for a guarantee on a specific OTT benefit.
steps.text: ఆ 299 ప్లాన్ లో Netflix వస్తుందా? గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వగలరా?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee a benefit not explicitly listed in the tool output.
steps.text: సిస్టమ్ లో OTT included అని మాత్రమే ఉంది. ఏ యాప్స్ వస్తాయో వివరాలు లేవు కాబట్టి నేను గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వలేను.

steps.purpose: Request a plan with higher data.
steps.text: సరే, నాకు రోజుకు 3GB data వచ్చే ప్లాన్ కావాలి. అది చూడండి.

steps.purpose: Search for plans with at least 3GB data.
Return the 3GB data plan.
Inform the user about the 3GB plan.
steps.text: 3GB data కోసం 399 రూపాయల ప్లాన్ ఉంది. దీని validity 28 రోజులు.

steps.purpose: Reject the new plan and ask to apply the old plan.
steps.text: అది చాలా ఎక్కువ. నా పాత ప్లాన్ P199 వేసేయండి. త్వరగా చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Apply the chosen recharge.
Return the recharge application status.
Confirm the successful recharge to the user.
steps.text: Recharge సక్సెస్ అయింది. Transaction ID TXN987. ఇది immediate గా effective అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask if anything else is needed.
Confirm completion and offer further help.
steps.text: లేదు సార్, మీ ప్లాన్ విజయవంతంగా యాక్టివేట్ అయింది. ఇంకేమైనా సహాయం కావాలా?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for a free Netflix subscription (an out-of-scope request) in e8. The agent correctly identifies it as unsupported and declines without hallucinating a policy or capability in e9.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Out-of-context identification and escalation > Out-of-Scope Request Identification

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds its response in e15 by refusing to guarantee Netflix since the tool only specified 'ott_included: true'. However, the agent violates grounding elsewhere by hallucinating the plan validity in e1 and 'per day' data benefits in e13 and e19.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e1, the agent states that the user's plan validity ends tomorrow before calling any tool to retrieve this information, violating the strict Tool Output Grounding requirement.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e1 so the agent states they are calling regarding the account or plan renewal, without claiming a specific validity timeframe since no tool has been called yet.

issues.detail: In e7, the agent fails to read the existing validity to the user before asking if they want to continue with the plan, which violates BR_TEL_04.
issues.repair_instruction: Update e7 to include the remaining validity (1 day) when reading the current state to the user.

issues.detail: The agent hallucinates that the data allowance is 'per day' (రోజుకు) for the plans in e13 and e19, which is not supported by the tool output.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the phrase 'రోజుకు' (per day) when describing the data benefits in e13 and e19, as the catalogue only specifies the total GB.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates out-of-scope identification and handles the OTT benefit grounding well. However, it fails on strict grounding and business rules due to the agent hallucinating the user's validity before a tool call, failing to read the validity back to the user before a recharge recommendation, and inventing a 'per day' data benefit not present in the catalogue.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for a free Netflix subscription, which is outside the supported workflow. The agent correctly identifies this as out of scope and declines the request without inventing any capabilities or policies.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Out-of-context identification and escalation > Out-of-Scope Request Identification

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely on the tool output. When the user asks for a guarantee about Netflix being included in the OTT bundle, the agent refuses to guarantee it because the tool result only states 'ott_included: true' without specifying the apps.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants. The agent handles an out-of-scope request appropriately and grounds all responses strictly on tool outputs, refusing to guarantee benefits not explicitly listed. The persona of a hurried professional is well-maintained, and the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode is followed correctly.

Adjusted step counts to maintain 5 tool calls and 16 spoken turns.
